exposure: lifestyle factors (diet, sleep duration, meat intake)
maternal health conditions (anemia, oligohydramnios, gestational diabetes)
cohort: Mothers who delivered newborns in a tertiary care hospital in Western Nepal between November 2016 and October 2017.
finding: Small for gestational age (SGA) is common in Western Nepal and is associated with several modifiable prognostic factors, including low socioeconomic status, low maternal sleep duration, infrequent meat intake, smoking, exposure to household air pollution, anemia, oligohydramnios, and gestational diabetes.
gest_age: Term, preterm, and postterm deliveries were included.
birth_weight: SGA babies had a lower average birth weight compared to those appropriate for gestational age (AGA).
